question: Obtain an expression for the drift velocity of free electrons in a conductor in terms of relaxation time and applied electric field.

options.A: $\vec{v}_d=-\dfrac{e\vec{E}\tau}{m}$; hence $v_d=\dfrac{eE\tau}{m}$ in magnitude and electron drift is opposite to $\vec E$.
options.B: $\vec{v}_d=\dfrac{e\vec{E}\tau}{m}$; electron drift is in the direction of $\vec E$.
options.C: $\vec{v}_d=-\dfrac{m\vec{E}}{e\tau}$; electron drift is opposite to $\vec E$.
options.D: $\vec{v}_d=\dfrac{e\tau}{m\vec{E}}$; electron drift is perpendicular to $\vec E$.
